page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.2xlarge is an x86_64 general purpose instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 processor-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external cloud block storage for operating system volumes and persistent data files. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default. Hardware acceleration is absent, with no GPUs attached to the virtual machine.

With its balanced compute and memory distribution, ecs.u2i-c1m4.2xlarge provides cost-efficient baseline resource scaling without the overhead of specialized hardware accelerators or attached NVMe storage. It is architected for enterprise web applications, intermediate database systems, backend microservices, build nodes, and continuous integration pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.2xlarge is a general purpose virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 architecture and deployed under the KVM hypervisor. The system provides 8 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.7 GHz, matched with 32.0 GB of memory to yield a standard 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per virtual core. It features a baseline network throughput of 5 Gbps and includes no local persistent storage or hardware GPUs, utilizing network-attached block storage for persistence. The balanced allocation of CPU and memory offers cost efficiency for applications that do not require dedicated hardware acceleration or heavy I/O operations. Appropriate workloads include multi-tier web applications, medium-scale relational databases, containerized application clusters, and enterprise development environments.
